title: ks.state: read rule, field objects, state_digest, savepoints
outcome: Reads record every object delivered (row + its field objects), digest for reconcile, savepoints for re-run simulation
acceptance: test_row_read_includes_field_objects and test_row_read_lists_field_obj (R2 store side): whole-row reads and aggregates list the row plus every existing field object; a projection without the field lists the row only
state_digest(fold(record)) equals the live store digest after a scripted 30-write sequence
savepoint/rollback API: a nested simulate() block leaves the store digest unchanged
summary: Review fixes (kabir). (1) savepoint()/simulate() now install a SQLite authorizer while open: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/SAVEPOINT/RELEASE issued on store.conn inside the block raise sqlite3.DatabaseError 'not authorized', so simulated code cannot persist its writes or drop the caller's. Backstop: if the txn/savepoint is gone on exit anyway, StateError (no silent return); txn() also raises StateError if the block ended the transaction. (2) Chose persist-and-refuse over required fields= (keeps tara's API; catches drift whatever the caller passes): sensitive_fields stored in meta on first open; reopen with a different FieldSchema -> StateError; fields=None adopts the persisted list; db with objects but no stored list -> StateError. (3) read() does tuple(project). Caller-visible changes: transaction-control SQL inside savepoint/simulate is refused; open_store/Store raise StateError on field-list mismatch; FieldSchema gains entries() and value equality. Signatures unchanged. Regressions: tests/state/test_b304_review.py (16 tests, probe cases incl.). tests/state+contracts 406 passed; full suite (excl. in-progress tests/world) 480 passed.
review:
[kabir · changes] All 3 acceptance criteria are met by tests that fail if the property breaks (test_row_read_includes_field_objects/_lists_field_obj incl. projection property loop, test_state_digest_fold_30_writes incl. visible_to prefixes, test_dryrun_savepoint). tests/state+contracts 389 passed. Two holes to fix, each with a regression test: (1) LEAK store.py:223-225 _rollback_savepoint returns silently if the txn is gone. Probe: COMMIT issued inside simulate() persists the simulated write (iban=EVIL, digest moved), no error. ROLLBACK inside simulate() within a caller txn silently drops the caller's kept writes; the only symptom is an OperationalError at txn COMMIT (store.py:188). Fix: simulate/savepoint raise StateError('transaction ended inside savepoint') when not in_transaction at exit. (2) READ-RULE HOLE store.py:161/427: fields defaults to empty and is not persisted. Store written without fields=, reopened with suppliers.iban: read(S17) returns iban with read_set=[row] only. Fix: store sensitive_fields in meta and refuse a mismatch on open (like schema, store.py:166-170), or require fields=. Minor: read() consumes a generator project twice (store.py:247 then :264), so it returns {} while listing iban. Safe direction, but do tuple(project) as read_table does (:273).

[kabir · done] Re-review: all 3 findings fixed with regression tests (tests/state/test_b304_review.py). tests/state+contracts 406 passed. Bypass probe (30 cases, simulate() alone and inside a caller txn): executescript COMMIT/SELECT, conn.commit()/rollback(), autocommit=True, isolation_level changes, END TRANSACTION, RELEASE ks_sp_1 all refused 'not authorized'; second connection gets 'database is locked'; a TEMP trigger RAISE(ROLLBACK) is caught by the StateError backstop. No simulated write reached disk and caller writes were kept. Field pinning: opened without fields then with fields -> StateError; legacy db with objects but no meta row -> StateError (also with fields=None); empty legacy db pins; order/duplicates compare equal; fields=None adopts the stored list and lists iban. Residual, not blocking: code that calls conn.set_authorizer(None), COMMITs and re-creates SAVEPOINT ks_sp_N persists writes silently. In-process code is trusted (agents never hold the conn), so this guard catches bugs, not malice; describe it that way. Minor: _end_savepoint sets the authorizer to None, which clobbers any authorizer the caller had installed.
